title: Accessing Levinson-Smith and Liénard equations in a nonlinear framework of quantum mechanics
summary: In this paper, we present the reduction of a recently introduced generalized quantum scheme of Chodos and Cooper to Levinson-Smith and Liénard classes of nonlinear system that enable us to furnish a wider class of acceptable solutions. In particular, for the Levinson-Smith equations, we find their relevance to position-dependent mass quantum systems, with an interesting off-shoot that solitonic-like solutions emerge from the condition of the level surface in the system.
